title: Query parameters
intro: The query has parameters. Each value is written into the text as an engine literal, with the right quotes; on the right you can see how it ends up.

invalid.date: Write the date as YYYY-MM-DD, with optional time (hh:mm or hh:mm:ss).

disable: Don't ask for parameters in this tab
disableTip: Runs the text as is and stops looking for parameters in this tab. It can be turned back on from the editor menu.
